new_lore_candidates.description: A historical/magical conflict exists in Barovia involving a vampire draining the lifeblood of the people for over 400 years, and the Burgomaster requests the party to 'encircle this land with the symbols of good' and contain the devil within the walls of weeping Barovia.
new_lore_candidates.evidence: The party read a message from the Burgomaster of Barovia detailing a curse and a request to encircle the land with symbols of good, referencing Marina Kuljana and a vampire.

new_lore_candidates.description: Strahd Von Zorovich is the manager of the establishment and the father/manager of the Burger Master, establishing a central conflict between the two figures.
new_lore_candidates.evidence: Strahd revealed that the Burger Master was the father of the owners and the manager of the establishment.

new_lore_candidates.description: The zombies encountered are described as being more capable and possessing a 'fire' within them, suggesting a non-standard undead nature.
new_lore_candidates.evidence: The zombies are described as being more capable and possessing a 'fire' within them, suggesting a non-standard undead nature.

new_lore_candidates.description: The land of Barovia is cursed by a vampire who has been draining the lifeblood of the people for over four centuries. The Burgomaster seeks to use symbols of good to contain the devil within the land.
new_lore_candidates.evidence: The note reveals a historical/magical conflict in Barovia involving a vampire draining the lifeblood of the people for over 400 years. The Burgomaster requests the party to 'encircle this land with the symbols of good' and contain the devil within the walls of weeping Barovia.

new_lore_candidates.description: The Burger Master is the father and manager of the establishment in Barovia, placing him in a central conflict with Strahd Von Zorovich over ownership and secrets.
new_lore_candidates.evidence: Strahd revealed that the Burger Master was the father of the owners and the manager of the establishment.
